name: 99 Speed Mart Retail Holdings Berhad
oneLine: Malaysia's leading chain of neighbourhood mini-marts, selling everyday groceries and household goods at low prices.
inPlainWords: Think of the 99 Speedmart shop near your house: small, close by, and stocked with daily essentials such as groceries, drinks, household products and personal care items.
It started as one sundry shop in Klang in 1987 and now has shops in every Malaysian state. In 2025 it opened five pilot shops in Fuzhou, China.
Its motto is "Near 'n Save": be close to where people live, and keep prices low by buying in very large volumes.

flow.label: Suppliers
flow.detail: Buys goods in bulk from brands and distributors. Suppliers also pay rebates and incentives, which lower its cost of goods.

flow.label: 22 distribution centres
flow.detail: Its own warehouses and lorries send stock to the shops, across Malaysia and China.

flow.label: 3,037 mini-marts
flow.detail: Small shops inside housing areas, plus the 99 Bulksales online platform for bulk orders.

flow.label: Shoppers
flow.detail: Customers pay at the till. No single customer makes up 10% or more of revenue.

moneyNote: For every RM100 of sales in 2025, about RM19.50 was left after the cost of the goods, and about RM5.30 was profit after all costs and tax (calculated from the reported figures).
